title: MCHeli weapon
description: A YAML file in assets/mcheli/weapons/ of an MCHeli addon pack. Generated from the game's schema declarations; do not edit.

DisplayName.description: The name shown in game; the file name when left out. Legacy TXT key: displayname.

Type.description: The weapon kind, such as 'machinegun1', 'aamissile' or 'bomb'. A TXT 'Type' line is read by type, which also changes the gravity of bombs and dispensers.

Group.description: Weapons of one group fire together. Legacy TXT key: group.

BaseDamage.description: Damage of a direct hit, before the damage factors. Legacy TXT key: power.

Acceleration.description: Speed added per tick, up to the projectile's speed. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: acceleration.

AccelerationInWater.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: accelerationinwater.

Gravity.description: Downward pull per tick. A legacy TXT 'Type = bomb' or 'dispenser' line sets it, and the in-water one, to -0.03; see type. The game clamps a value outside -50 to 50 and says so. Legacy TXT key: gravity.

GravityInWater.description: The game clamps a value outside -50 to 50 and says so. Legacy TXT key: gravityinwater.

VelocityInWater.description: Speed kept per tick under water. Legacy TXT key: velocityinwater.

SpeedFactor.description: Speed change per tick between the start and end tick; positive accelerates. Legacy TXT key: speedfactor.

SpeedDependsAircraft.description: The projectile starts with the shooter's velocity added. Legacy TXT key: speeddependsaircraft.

Piercing.description: Blocks or entities the projectile passes through. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: piercing.

FlakSpread.description: Spread of the block-break particles on impact, 0.1 for a rifle to 0.6 for an anti-tank round. Legacy TXT key: flakparticlesdiff.

Sound.description: The firing sound and how it plays.

Delay.description: Ticks between the shot and its sound. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: sounddelay.

Volume.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: soundvolume.

Pitch.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1 and says so. Legacy TXT key: soundpitch.

PitchRandom.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1 and says so. Legacy TXT key: soundpitchrandom.

HitSoundRange.description: Blocks within which players hear the hit sound. Legacy TXT key: hitsoundrange.

Fire.description: A sound id, or a YAML map that also defines the sound for the client (see 'SoundRegistry#parseSound(Map)'). Reading registers the sound; the emitter writes the id. A sound id such as 'mcheli:gun', or a map that also defines the sound for the client. Legacy TXT key: sound.

Hit.description: A sound id, or a YAML map that also defines the sound for the client (see 'SoundRegistry#parseSound(Map)'). Reading registers the sound; the emitter writes the id. A sound id such as 'mcheli:gun', or a map that also defines the sound for the client. Legacy TXT key: hitsound.

Railgun.description: A sound id, or a YAML map that also defines the sound for the client (see 'SoundRegistry#parseSound(Map)'). Reading registers the sound; the emitter writes the id. A sound id such as 'mcheli:gun', or a map that also defines the sound for the client. Legacy TXT key: railgunsound.

HitMetal.description: No longer supported: the game ignores this key and says so once per load. You can delete it.

WeaponSwitch.description: No longer supported: the game ignores this key and says so once per load. You can delete it.

Name.description: A sound id such as 'mcheli:gun', or a map that also defines the sound for the client. Another place for 'Sound.Locations.Fire'; converted files write it there.

Recoil.description: How the shot kicks the vehicle and the view.

Power.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: recoil.

Pitch.description: Vertical kick of the view. Legacy TXT key: recoilpitch.

Yaw.description: Horizontal kick, always to the same side. Legacy TXT key: recoilyaw.

PitchRange.description: Random extra vertical kick. Legacy TXT key: recoilpitchrange.

YawRange.description: Random horizontal kick, to either side. Legacy TXT key: recoilyawrange.

Power.description: Explosion strength; 0 for none. TXT 'Explosion' is clamped to 0..200. Legacy TXT key: explosion.

Radio.description: Explosion size; 0 means POWER. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so.

DamageRadio.description: Radius within which the explosion hurts; 0 means the explosion size. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so.

DestructionPower.description: Strength against blocks; -1 means POWER. Legacy TXT key: explosionblock.

ExplosionAltitude.description: Height above ground at which the projectile explodes on its own. Legacy TXT key: explosionaltitude.

FuseTime.description: Ticks of flight before the projectile explodes; 0 for no time fuse. Legacy TXT key: timefuse.

FuseDelay.description: Ticks between the first impact and the explosion. Legacy TXT key: delayfuse.

FuseRebound.description: Bounciness while a delayed fuse burns; ignored without one. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: bound.

ExplosionAirburst.description: Strength of an airburst; 0 means POWER. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 50 and says so. Legacy TXT key: explosionairburst.

ThroughWallFactor.description: Share of the damage that passes a wall. TXT clamps it to 0..1. Legacy TXT key: explosionthroughwallfactor.

NewBreak.description: Use the newer block breaking, which honours DESTRUCTION_POWER and the radii. Legacy TXT key: isnewexplosionbreak.

ProximityFuseDist.description: Distance to a target at which the projectile explodes. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 2000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: proximityfusedist.

FAE.description: A fuel-air explosion: no underwater power, needs an explosion power. Legacy TXT key: fae.

Type.description: No longer supported: the game ignores this key and says so once per load. You can delete it.

CanDestroyBlocks.description: No longer supported: the game ignores this key and says so once per load. You can delete it.

Camera.description: The gunner's view while this weapon is selected.

RotationSpeedPitch.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: camerarotationspeedpitch.

CCIP.description: Continuously computed impact point; only rockets and AT and TV missiles support it. Legacy TXT key: ccip.

CCIPFactor.description: Scale of the CCIP marker. TXT clamps it to 0.1..10. Legacy TXT key: ccipfactor.

Sight.description: 'movesight' or 'missilesight', any case. Any case. Legacy TXT key: sight.

Zoom.description: Zoom steps: one number, or a list each clamped to 0..10. Legacy TXT writes 'Zoom = 1.25, 2, 4' and clamps each step to 0.1..10. One zoom step, or a list of them; each is kept within 0 to 10. Legacy TXT key: zoom.

Missile.description: Guidance, with the 'LockOn', 'Radar' and 'Heat' seeker settings in their own sections.

LaserGuidance.description: TV missiles steer by laser. Legacy TXT key: laserguidance.

IsOffAxis.description: Air-to-air missiles may be fired off boresight. Legacy TXT key: enableoffaxis.

PredictTargetPos.description: Lead the target instead of chasing it. Legacy TXT key: predicttargetpos.

EnableBVR.description: Beyond-visual-range targeting. Legacy TXT key: enablebvr.

ScanInterval.description: Ticks between active radar scans. Legacy TXT key: scaninterval.

TickEndHoming.description: Ticks a lost lock is kept; -1 keeps it for good. The game clamps a value outside -1 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: tickendhoming.

PDHDNMaxDegree.description: Largest look-down angle of a pulse-Doppler seeker; the default is outside the range on purpose (no limit). The game clamps a value outside -1 to 90 and says so. Legacy TXT key: pdhdnmaxdegree.

PDHDNMaxDegreeLockOutCount.description: Ticks past that angle before the lock breaks. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 200 and says so. Legacy TXT key: pdhdnmaxdegreelockoutcount.

TurningFactor.description: Manoeuvrability: 1 is vanilla, 0.1 recommended. Legacy TXT key: turningfactor, laserstartdistance.

MaxDegreeOfMissile.description: Largest angle the seeker tracks. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: maxdegreeofmissile.

BallisticMissile.description: No longer supported: the game ignores this key and says so once per load. You can delete it.

AntiRadiationMissile.description: Homes on radar emitters. Legacy TXT key: antiradiationmissile.

EmitterLostGraceTick.description: No longer supported: the game ignores this key and says so once per load. You can delete it.

Time.description: Ticks to lock. TXT clamps it to 2..1000. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: locktime.

Delay.description: Ticks after launch before the seeker steers. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: rigiditytime.

MaxRange.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 2000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: maxlockonrange.

MaxAngle.description: Largest angle off the aircraft's nose a lock can start at. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 200 and says so. Legacy TXT key: maxlockonangle.

MinHeight.description: Below this height the target hides in ground clutter; -1 for no limit. The game clamps a value outside -1 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: lockminheight.

PassiveRadarLockOutCount.description: Ticks a semi-active missile flies on after losing the launcher's guidance. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 200 and says so. Legacy TXT key: passiveradarlockoutcount.

LockedChaffMax.description: Chaff locks before the missile goes ballistic. Legacy TXT key: numlockedchaffmax.

LockInWater.description: Targets sitting in water (ships, boats) may be locked. YAML only.

IsRadarMissile.description: Chaff fools it. Legacy TXT key: isradarmissile.

ActiveRadar.description: Tracks on its own after launch. Legacy TXT key: activeradar.

PassiveRadar.description: Semi-active: needs the launcher to keep the lock. Legacy TXT key: passiveradar.

SemiActiveRadar.description: No longer supported: the game ignores this key and says so once per load. You can delete it.

isHeatMissile.description: Flares fool it. Legacy TXT key: isheatseekermissile.

HeatCount.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: heatcount.

MaxHeatCount.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: maxheatcount.

AntiFlareCount.description: Ticks the seeker ignores flares; -1 for never. The game clamps a value outside -1 to 200 and says so. Legacy TXT key: antiflarecount.

ReloadTime.description: Ticks to reload. The game clamps a value outside 3 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: reloadtime.

MagSize.description: Rounds per magazine; 0 means the maximum ammo. The game clamps a value outside 1 to 30000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: round.

MaxAmmo.description: Rounds carried in reserve, besides the loaded magazine. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 30000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: maxammo.

ResupplyCount.description: Rounds a resupply gives. The game clamps a value outside 1 to 30000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: suppliednum.

Count.description: The game clamps a value outside 1 to 64 and says so.

Num.description: The game clamps a value outside 1 to 64 and says so.

Meta.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 32767 and says so.

Damage.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 32767 and says so.

AmmoItems.description: Items a reload uses up: Name (or Loc) is the item id, Count (or Num) how many.

FireCooldown.description: Ticks between shots. TXT clamps it to 0..100000. Legacy TXT key: delay.

Target.description: What the weapon may lock on to or hit. Words anywhere in the text: planes, helicopters, vehicles (or tanks), players, monsters, others; or block alone. Legacy TXT key: target.

Mode.description: Fire modes the weapon cycles through. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: modenum.

FixMode.description: The mode the weapon is fixed to, if below the mode count. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 10 and says so. Legacy TXT key: fixmode.

RidableOnly.description: Only a seated gunner may fire it. Legacy TXT key: ridableonly.

Accuracy.description: Random spread; 0 is perfectly accurate. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: accuracy.

SelfDestruct.description: Fires once and destroys itself, as a demolition charge does. Legacy TXT key: destruct.

CanLoadChunks.description: The projectile keeps the chunks it flies through loaded. Legacy TXT key: enablechunkloader.

Color.description: A colour: hex '#AARRGGBB' or '#RRGGBB', or a list [a, r, g, b] of numbers from 0 to 1.
A colour: hex '#AARRGGBB' or '#RRGGBB', or a list [a, r, g, b] of numbers from 0 to 1.

BulletModel.description: Bullet model name; empty for the weapon type's default model. Legacy TXT key: modelbullet.

TrajectoryParticle.description: A particle name; 'none' turns the trail off. Legacy TXT key: trajectoryparticle.

TrajectoryParticleStartTick.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 10000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: trajectoryparticlestarttick.

FlakParticlesCrack.description: Block-break particles on impact. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 300 and says so. Legacy TXT key: flakparticlescrack.

ParticlesFlak.description: White smoke particles on impact. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: particlesflak.

SmokeSize.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: smokesize.

SmokeNum.description: The game clamps a value outside 1 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: smokenum.

SmokeMaxAge.description: Ticks a smoke particle lives. The game clamps a value outside 2 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: smokemaxage.

BulletColorInWater.description: A colour: hex '#AARRGGBB' or '#RRGGBB', or a list [a, r, g, b] of numbers from 0 to 1.

BulletColor.description: Also tints the smoke trail. A colour: hex '#AARRGGBB' or '#RRGGBB', or a list [a, r, g, b] of numbers from 0 to 1.

DeployTime.description: Ticks of flight before the bomblets deploy. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: bombletstime.

Spread.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: bombletdiff.

Ahead.description: An AHEAD round: bursts ahead of the target. Legacy TXT key: ahead.

Effects.description: What a hit does beyond damage.

PotionEffects.description: Potion (or Name) is an effect id such as minecraft:poison; Duration is in ticks.

BulletDecay.description: The curves of a weapon; YAML adds one, the emitter writes the first. Type Segmented; each segment is [start distance, damage factor].

Location.description: The item a dispenser places or uses, such as 'water_bucket'.

DispenseRange.description: Blocks around the impact the dispenser covers. The game clamps a value outside 1 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: dispenserange.

Length.description: Length of a beam or cone weapon. The game clamps a value outside 1 to 300 and says so. Legacy TXT key: length.

Radius.description: Radius of a beam or cone weapon. The game clamps a value outside 1 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: radius.

MarkTime.description: Ticks a spotted target stays marked; the game keeps it one tick longer than written. The game clamps a value outside 1 to 30000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: marktime.

DamageFactor.description: Factors are read as written; the YAML reader used to drop the fraction, which made a converted 'DamageFactor = player, 0.5' line come back as 0. Target to damage multiplier: Player, Helicopter (or Heli), Plane, Ship, Tank, Vehicle, or an entity class name.

Count.description: The game clamps a value outside 1 to 1000 and says so.

PayloadType.description: 'Rocket', any case; anything else fires bullets. Any case.

Fuze.description: 'ProximityPlayer' or 'ProximityVehicle', any case; any other name is not a mine. Any case.

Range.description: Blocks within which the trigger sets the mine off. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 256 and says so.

ArmDelay.description: Ticks after landing before the mine can go off. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000000 and says so.

NTM.description: Hammer's Nuclear Tech explosion settings, used only with that mod installed.
